usageNotes: Permanently removes a cluster-wide directory mapping by its config ID; the mapping must not be actively referenced by any guest or resource pool, or the delete may be blocked. Requires the `Mapping.Modify` privilege on `/mapping/dir` — typically held by the root user or a delegated administrator role. Returns null synchronously (no UPID); the mapping is gone immediately upon success.
destructiveReason: Deletes the named directory mapping from the cluster configuration permanently; any guest storage reference pointing to this mapping will become unresolvable until reconfigured.
tips: Use list_cluster_mapping_dir (GET /cluster/mapping/dir) first to confirm the exact config ID before deleting.
Check all guest storage configurations to ensure no VM/CT is actively using this mapping before removal.
The `id` must match the `pve-configid` format: alphanumeric with hyphens and underscores, no spaces.
